_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular register fragment — never edit shillinq_register.json
_meta.description: Tier 2 — intercompany elimination engine. Adds seven schemas (IntercompanyRelation, IntercompanyTransaction, IntercompanyMatch, IntercompanyMismatch, ToleranceRule, CounterpartyBalance, EliminationJournal) implementing.010. Matching and counterparty roll-up are declared as x-openregister-aggregations per ADR-031; tolerance evaluation, elimination-journal balance and cross-period roll-forward are enforced via x-openregister-lifecycle.requires guards on the ADR-031 exception path (cross-schema aggregation cannot yet be expressed in the declarative lifecycle DSL), implemented in lib/Lifecycle against the real OpenRegister ObjectService API (find/findAll/saveObject). Five default ToleranceRule template objects are seeded (sales-of-goods, sales-of-services, interest-on-loan, dividend, management-fee). Depends on bookkeeping-consolidation-commercial (ConsolidationGroup), bookkeeping-multi-administratie (Administration GL) and bookkeeping-grootboek (GLTransaction/GLLine).

IntercompanyRelation.title: Intercompany Relation
IntercompanyRelation.description: Persistent registration of an intercompany relation between two entities in a consolidation group, including the relevant general-ledger accounts on both sides, the relation type, and tolerance settings the matching engine uses to pair transactions.

relationId.description: Unique identifier of the relation within the consolidation group.
relationId.title: Relation ID

entityAId.description: FK to the first entity (administration) of the relation.
entityAId.title: Entity A ID

entityBId.description: FK to the second entity (administration) of the relation.
entityBId.title: Entity B ID

relationType.description: Economic nature of the intercompany relation; drives default tolerance and elimination treatment.
relationType.title: Relation Type

defaultAccountA.description: Default GL account on entity A's side (e.g. '8200 - IC revenue').
defaultAccountA.title: Default Account A

defaultAccountB.description: Default GL account on entity B's side (e.g. '4400 - IC purchases').
defaultAccountB.title: Default Account B

toleranceAbsolute.description: Absolute mismatch threshold in EUR (default EUR 10).
toleranceAbsolute.title: Tolerance Absolute

toleranceFallbackAccount.description: Rounding-difference fallback GL account for within-tolerance residuals (e.g. '9999 - Elimination rounding').
toleranceFallbackAccount.title: Tolerance Fallback Account

activeTo.description: End date of the relation; null means currently active.
activeTo.title: Active To

IntercompanyTransaction.title: Intercompany Transaction
IntercompanyTransaction.description: An auto-detected or explicitly-marked intercompany transaction sourced from a group entity's general ledger, carrying counterparty identification and detection confidence.

sourceAdministrationId.description: FK to the source administration the transaction was booked in.
sourceAdministrationId.title: Source Administration ID

sourceJournalEntryId.description: FK to the source journal entry (T1 JournalEntry/GLTransaction).
sourceJournalEntryId.title: Source Journal Entry ID

sourceLineNumber.description: Line number within the source journal entry.
sourceLineNumber.title: Source Line Number

bookingDate.description: Booking date of the source line.
bookingDate.title: Booking Date

glAccount.description: General-ledger account in the source administration.
glAccount.title: GL Account

description.description: Description copied from the source journal line.
description.title: Description

counterpartyEntityId.description: FK to the detected or asserted counterparty entity (administration).
counterpartyEntityId.title: Counterparty Entity ID

relationId.description: FK to the matched IntercompanyRelation, when known.
relationId.title: Relation ID

detectionMethod.description: How the transaction was identified as intercompany.
detectionMethod.title: Detection Method

detectionConfidence.description: Confidence of the detection; label-based defaults to medium pending operator confirmation.
detectionConfidence.title: Detection Confidence

isMatched.description: Whether the transaction has been included in a match.
isMatched.title: Is Matched

matchId.description: FK to the IntercompanyMatch the transaction belongs to.
matchId.title: Match ID

IntercompanyMatch.title: Intercompany Match
IntercompanyMatch.description: A paired set of intercompany transactions from two entities for one relation and period, with the aggregated A/B totals, the mismatch delta, and the tolerance-evaluated match status. Created via the matching aggregation; the create transition is guarded by IntercompanyToleranceGuard and the roll-forward consistency check.

entityATransactionIds.description: UUIDs of the IntercompanyTransaction rows on entity A's side.
entityATransactionIds.title: Entity A Transaction Ids

entityBTransactionIds.description: UUIDs of the IntercompanyTransaction rows on entity B's side.
entityBTransactionIds.title: Entity B Transaction Ids

totalAmountA.description: Aggregated amount on entity A's side, in group reporting currency.
totalAmountA.title: Total Amount A

totalAmountB.description: Aggregated amount on entity B's side, in group reporting currency.
totalAmountB.title: Total Amount B

mismatchPercentage.description: Relative difference in percent of the larger side.
mismatchPercentage.title: Mismatch Percentage

generatedEliminationId.description: FK to the generated EliminationJournal, when an elimination was produced.
generatedEliminationId.title: Generated Elimination ID

matchByRelationPeriod.description: Declarative shape of the per-relation, per-period matching the engine computes. Groups IntercompanyTransaction by (relationId, periodId) within the consolidation, sums entity-A-side and entity-B-side amounts (debit minus credit per side) into totalAmountA/totalAmountB, and derives mismatchAmount = totalAmountA - totalAmountB. The tolerance evaluation that sets matchStatus runs in the create lifecycle guard. When the OpenRegister aggregation engine cannot express the per-side conditional sum, the same result is computed in PHP from the real ObjectService API (findAll).

perfect-match.label: Perfect match
perfect-match.description: A and B sides are equal; elimination may be generated.

within-tolerance.label: Within tolerance
within-tolerance.description: Mismatch is within the configured ToleranceRule; residual posts to the fallback account.

outside-tolerance.label: Outside tolerance
outside-tolerance.description: Mismatch exceeds tolerance; escalated to the exception queue, no auto-elimination.

one-sided-A.label: One-sided (A)
one-sided-A.description: Only entity A booked the transaction; awaiting the counterparty booking.

one-sided-B.label: One-sided (B)
one-sided-B.description: Only entity B booked the transaction; awaiting the counterparty booking.

create.label: Evaluate tolerance
create.description: On match creation, evaluate the mismatch against the configured ToleranceRule and verify cross-period roll-forward consistency. Implemented on the ADR-031 exception path because cross-schema aggregation is not yet expressible in the declarative lifecycle DSL.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Intercompany Match is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp.

IntercompanyMismatch.title: Intercompany Mismatch
IntercompanyMismatch.description: An exception record for a discrepancy that fell outside tolerance, classified by cause and tracked through a semi-automated resolution path.

matchId.description: FK to the IntercompanyMatch the mismatch belongs to, when part of a match.
matchId.title: Match ID

causeClassification.description: Operator-assigned cause of the discrepancy; drives the resolution path.
causeClassification.title: Cause Classification

amount.description: Mismatch amount in EUR or source currency.
amount.title: Amount

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency of the mismatch amount.
currency.title: Currency

assigneeId.description: FK to the Nextcloud user investigating the mismatch.
assigneeId.title: Assignee ID

resolutionAction.description: Chosen resolution path for the mismatch.
resolutionAction.title: Resolution Action

resolutionNotes.description: Free-text explanation of the chosen resolution.
resolutionNotes.title: Resolution Notes

accepted-as-difference.label: Accepted as difference
accepted-as-difference.description: Difference accepted and booked to the fallback/CTA account.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Intercompany Mismatch is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp.

ToleranceRule.title: Tolerance Rule
ToleranceRule.description: A configurable mismatch-acceptance rule (absolute + relative thresholds combined via a tolerance method) optionally scoped to a relation type, with an auto-resolve flag.

groupId.description: FK to ConsolidationGroup; a group-wide default rule.
groupId.title: Group ID

relationTypeFilter.description: Relation type the rule applies to; null means all relation types.
relationTypeFilter.title: Relation Type Filter

toleranceMethod.description: How the absolute and relative thresholds are combined: max-of (either passes), min-of (both must pass), or absolute-only.
toleranceMethod.title: Tolerance Method

fallbackAccount.description: GL account the within-tolerance residual posts to.
fallbackAccount.title: Fallback Account

autoResolve.description: Whether within-tolerance mismatches are accepted automatically.
autoResolve.title: Auto Resolve

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Tolerance Rule is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp.

CounterpartyBalance.title: Counterparty Balance
CounterpartyBalance.description: An aggregated per-counterparty-pair, per-period view of outstanding intercompany receivables, payables, net position, flows and mismatch count. Read-only; refreshed by each matching run.

totalReceivablesAonB.description: Total outstanding receivables of A on B.
totalReceivablesAonB.title: Total Receivables Aon B

totalPayablesAtoB.description: Total outstanding payables of A to B.
totalPayablesAtoB.title: Total Payables Ato B

netPositionAtoB.description: Net position of A versus B (receivables - payables).
netPositionAtoB.title: Net Position Ato B

totalSalesAtoB.description: Total sales flow A to B in the period.
totalSalesAtoB.title: Total Sales Ato B

totalPurchasesAtoB.description: Total purchase flow A from B in the period.
totalPurchasesAtoB.title: Total Purchases Ato B

transactionCount.description: Number of intercompany transactions in the period.
transactionCount.title: Transaction Count

mismatchCount.description: Number of reported mismatches in the period.
mismatchCount.title: Mismatch Count

counterpartyBalanceByPair.description: Declarative shape of the per-pair, per-period counterparty roll-up the engine computes. Groups IntercompanyTransaction by (entityAId, entityBId, periodId) within the consolidation and sums receivables, payables, sales and purchase flows, counting transactions and related mismatches. When the OpenRegister aggregation engine cannot express the multi-source roll-up, the same result is computed in PHP from the real ObjectService API (findAll).

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Counterparty Balance is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp.

EliminationJournal.title: Elimination Journal
EliminationJournal.description: A generated elimination journal entry living in the consolidation layer (never in the source administrations), with balanced debit/credit lines per matched transaction pair and an audit reference back to the triggering match. Lines MUST balance: totalDebit equals totalCredit, enforced by the EliminationBalanceGuard on the create transition.

lines.description: Balanced debit/credit lines. The sum of debitAmount MUST equal the sum of creditAmount.

glAccount.description: GL account of the elimination line.
glAccount.title: GL Account

lines.title: Lines

totalDebit.description: Sum of debit amounts; MUST equal totalCredit.
totalDebit.title: Total Debit

totalCredit.description: Sum of credit amounts; MUST equal totalDebit.
totalCredit.title: Total Credit

generatedBy.description: Whether the journal was auto-generated by the matching run or entered manually.
generatedBy.title: Generated By

approvedBy.description: FK to the Nextcloud user who approved the elimination.
approvedBy.title: Approved By

system.label: System-generated
system.description: Materialised automatically by the matching run.

create.label: Verify balance
create.description: On creation, verify the elimination lines balance (sum of debits equals sum of credits) before persisting. ADR-031 exception path: cross-line aggregation is not yet expressible in the declarative lifecycle DSL.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Elimination Journal is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp.
